suites.name: together
suites.description: text.cue is written into package m at #at, as a file of its own beside in.cue, and the package is loaded and looked up at #at. This is a lineage declared in a field of a loaded package, as cmd/thema -p, exemplars and testdata/cases bind it.

suites.name: compose
suites.description: text.cue is parsed on its own and composed into package m at #at with thema.Compose, and the package is loaded with the composed file beside in.cue. This is how a tool composes separately compiled lineages into the package that uses them (#272).
